title: Driving Licence (DL) — Renewal & Duplicate Licence Issuance
authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) / State Transport Departments (Sarathi Parivahan)
verification_source: Central Motor Vehicles Rules & Sarathi Parivahan National Portal
overview: Official procedures to renew an expired Driving Licence (DL) or apply for a duplicate Driving Licence in the event of loss, theft, mutilation, or physical damage.
eligibility: Renewal: Holder of an Indian Driving Licence that has expired or is nearing expiry (can be renewed up to 1 year prior to expiry and up to 1 year post expiry under standard rules). Duplicate: Any valid licence holder who lost their physical smart card or whose card is illegible.

fees.amount: DL Renewal Base Fee: ₹200.00 | Duplicate DL: ₹200.00 (plus ₹200 smart card fee where applicable)
fees.breakdown: Standard renewal fee is ₹200. If applying after the 1-year grace period, an additional late fee of ₹300 plus ₹1,000 for each year or part thereof of delay applies. State user convenience fees (₹50-₹100) may vary by jurisdiction.
fees.payment_mode: Online payment via Government Treasury Payment Gateway on Sarathi Parivahan portal.

timeline.dispatch: Aadhaar-authenticated contactless renewal is processed within 7 to 14 working days by the jurisdictional RTO.
timeline.delivery: Digital DL is immediately reflected on mParivahan and DigiLocker upon approval; physical smart card is dispatched via Speed Post.

required_documents: Original Expired / Damaged Driving Licence (or copy if lost)
For Lost DL: Form LLD (Intimation of loss or destruction) and Police Lost Article Report / NCR / FIR copy
For Renewal: Form 2 (Application form auto-generated online)
Medical Certificate (Form 1A): Mandatory for non-transport commercial licence holders OR applicants over 40 years of age, signed by a registered medical practitioner (digitally uploaded via portal)
Proof of Address (Aadhaar, Passport, or Voter ID) and Proof of Age
steps: Visit the official Parivahan Sarathi portal: https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/
Select the State in which your licence was issued or where you currently reside.
Click on 'Apply for DL Renewal' or 'Services on DL (Renewal / Duplicate / Address Change)'.
Enter your Driving Licence Number and Date of Birth, then click 'Get DL Details'.
Confirm that the licensee details displayed match your profile.
Select the required service: 'Renewal of DL' or 'Issue of Duplicate DL'.
If opting for Aadhaar-based e-KYC (contactless service in participating states), authenticate via Aadhaar OTP to avoid in-person RTO visits.
Upload required documents (Form 1A medical cert if over 40 years, Form LLD/FIR if lost).
Pay the prescribed government fee online through the payment gateway.
Download the application acknowledgment and track approval status on the portal.
warnings_and_fraud_prevention: Driving on public roads with an expired licence beyond the grace period is a punishable violation under the Motor Vehicles Act carrying a ₹5,000 fine.
Beware of third-party middlemen charging ₹2,000-₹5,000; the official government fee is only ₹200-₹400 on the Sarathi portal.
Ensure the DL number format strictly matches your physical card (e.g., TN-01-20150001234 or DL0420150001234).
checklist: Locate your Driving Licence Number and confirm Date of Birth
If over 40 years old, obtain Form 1A Medical Certificate from a registered doctor
If DL was lost, file an online Police Lost Report/NCR to obtain reference number
Keep Aadhaar linked mobile ready for contactless e-KYC authentication
